text:
Predicates:
Top10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
JapaneseCompany(y) ::: y is a Japanese game company.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
LegendOfZelda ::: the Legend of Zelda.
Premises:
CreatedBy(theLegendOfZelda, theGameCompany) ::: The Legend of Zelda was created by a game company.
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(x, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
¬Top10(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
